subjects.label: Servers and matchmaking queues
subjects.description: The servers being down or the matchmaking queue never resolving so that the game cannot be entered at all, including login failures and the endless main-menu wait; lag inside a heist that does start does not belong here.

subjects.label: Always-online and offline mode
subjects.description: The requirement to reach the servers even to play alone, requests for an offline mode, and the move from peer-to-peer hosting to dedicated servers; the servers merely being down belongs under the outage row.

subjects.label: Compared with the previous game
subjects.description: Whether this entry is a step down from, the same as, or a replacement for the previous game in the series, including how much it shipped with next to what the earlier one had; comparisons with games outside the series do not belong here.

subjects.label: Heist count and roster
subjects.description: How many heists ship, which named heists players love or miss, and which locations they want added; the tasks inside a heist belong under the objectives row.

subjects.label: Stealth versus loud
subjects.description: The choice between running a heist quietly or going loud, which of the two is fun or dead, and restarting a long stealth run when caught; weapons and builds belong in their own row.

subjects.label: Heist objectives and chores
subjects.description: The tasks inside a heist, such as hunting for a USB stick, scanning QR codes, lockpicking and carrying loot bags, and whether the objectives are shown clearly or turn into tedium; the choice of approach belongs under stealth versus loud.

subjects.label: Weapons, builds and unlocks
subjects.description: Gun damage and weapon levels, skill and perk builds, challenges that gate experience and unlocks, and pre-heist favours bought with money; the number of heists belongs under the roster row.

subjects.label: Bring back from the last game
subjects.description: Named heisters, heists, DLC packs, builds and the peer-to-peer model that players ask to have returned from the previous game; a verdict that the new game is better or worse than the old one belongs under the predecessor row.

subjects.label: Recipes posted as reviews
subjects.description: Cooking recipes written out in full in place of a review, as a joke about the time spent waiting for the servers or matchmaking; cooking metaphors such as letting the developers cook do not belong here.
